spec.expr:
(
  time() - max_over_time(timestamp(network_ups_tools_ups_status{ups="$ups", flag="OL"} == 0)[24h:1m])
  or
  time() - min_over_time(timestamp(network_ups_tools_ups_status{ups="$ups", flag="OL"})[24h:1m])
)
and on(ups) (network_ups_tools_ups_status{ups="$ups", flag="OL"} == 1)

(
  max_over_time(timestamp(network_ups_tools_ups_status{ups="$ups", flag="OL"} == 1)[24h:1m]) - time()
  or
  min_over_time(timestamp(network_ups_tools_ups_status{ups="$ups", flag="OL"})[24h:1m]) - time()
)
and on(ups) (network_ups_tools_ups_status{ups="$ups", flag="OL"} == 0)
